title: Skin rash in meningitis and meningoencephalitis (Tsai, Nagel, Gilden; Neurology 2013;80(19):1808-1811)

claims.text: An erythematous macular and petechial rash on the legs that quickly disseminates and becomes purpuric/necrotic indicates meningococcal infection (Neisseria meningitidis) with untreated meningococcemia.
claims.byte_quote: Meningococcal rash is similar, an erythematous macular and petechial rash on the legs that quickly disseminates, becoming purpuric and even necrotic if meningococcemia remains untreated

claims.text: Rocky Mountain spotted fever rash begins as erythematous macules on the wrists, hands, and feet.
claims.byte_quote: The classic rash of Rocky Mountain spotted fever usually begins as erythematous macules on the wrists, hands, and feet

claims.text: A maculopapular rash on the palms and soles that is scaly without much erythema indicates secondary or tertiary syphilis.
claims.byte_quote: The maculopapular rash of secondary or tertiary syphilis is seen mostly on the palms of the hands and soles of the feet and is scaly without much erythema

claims.text: HSV cutaneous lesions cluster in patches.
VZV produces lesions in a dermatomal distribution.
claims.byte_quote: VZV produces lesions in a dermatomal distribution

claims.text: Lyme disease skin rash has a characteristic 'target' appearance.
claims.byte_quote: The skin rash in Lyme disease has a characteristic 'target' appearance
